There's something called a Teesny 2.0 which is what many keyboard builders use as a controller device after mounting switches to a PCB (or just soldering wires to each switch pin is a possibility, I think). The teensy is a pretty decent choice but has a lower clock speed and fewer gpios (i think) than the zero.
